restart.description: Restarts a container monitored by Monitor Docker.

server.name: Server

restart.name: Restart

user.description: Set up the connection to the Docker host.

data_description.name: Unique name for this Docker host, used as the prefix of its entity IDs.
data_description.url: Leave empty to use the local socket. For a remote daemon, use e.g. tcp://ip:2375 or https://ip:2376, without a trailing slash.
data_description.certpath: Directory holding ca.pem, cert.pem and key.pem. Setting it enables TLS for a TCP connection.
data_description.retry: How long to wait before reconnecting after a TCP error.

data_description.containers: Leave empty to monitor all containers, including ones created later.
data_description.ignore_ephemeral: When monitoring all containers, skip those started with --rm or with restart policy "no".

data_description.monitored_docker_conditions: Sensors to create for the Docker host.
data_description.monitored_container_conditions: Sensors to create for each container.

abort.already_configured: A Docker host with this name is already configured.
